 Leo Horoscope for November 2026
 July 23 - Aug 22 
 Share
 Your November 2026 Horoscope for Leo
 by Susan Miller 
 Now, let’s backtrack to earlier in the month.
 The new moon will appear on November 9 in Scorpio at 17º, filling your fourth house of home and family. This new moon has a mixed outlook because Mars in Leo will be at odds with both the Sun and this new moon in Scorpio. You may feel conflicted or frustrated about a decision or relationship with someone connected to your home or other property. That person might be your landlord, contractor, real estate broker, interior designer, or your roommate or spouse (as some examples). Someone will not be cooperating with you and will be resisting your suggestions.
 Nothing will be exactly straightforward this month—or, I should say, in the first half of the month—because Mercury, the planet of communication and contractual matters, will be retrograde in Scorpio (your fourth house of home) until November 13. That will affect your plans to renovate, improve your home, have furniture delivered, find a new place to live, or see a beloved relative. You will need to have patience.
 Mars and Jupiter will move to conjunction in Leo on November 16—this will be dynamite for you. Take advantage of this magical day.
